purpose: post-lock supplementary temporal and database-version validation

positive_labels.rule: Retain non-obsolete, coordinate-valid structural-state disorder annotations with a permitted direct experimental ECO term, curator information, validator information, and no unresolved construct alteration.

negative_labels.source: PDBe and SIFTS mapped experimentally observed PDB residues

reporting_constraint: S2 must be described as a database-curated supplementary validation set without exhaustive article-by-article re-curation; CAID2 and CAID3 remain the primary external benchmarks.
